gaps.notes: Dispatch intercept, park reason, event payload and phase tool surface landed. The DM accept path still does not compact the source into a colony queen seed (separate open gap).
gaps.title: suggest_colony has no Go dispatch/intercept

gaps.notes: The colony phase now exposes new_colony and the agentloop intercept/pending-pivot/event path landed. The lean-handoff accept endpoint landed in colony_pivot_lean.go (gap:colony_pivot_lean_handoff is fixed).
gaps.title: task_create(new_colony=true) pivot has no production Go handler

gaps.notes: Accepting a colony-phase pivot creates a sibling colony from goal/handoff/tasks: fresh queen session seeded with the handoff brief only, plan seeded before the session opens, no transcript copy, no compaction, source colony stays live and unlocked. The HTTP test asserts 201, handoff-only transcript, seeded plan, COLONY_CREATED skipped/colony and pivot cleared.
gaps.title: colony pivot accept (lean-handoff sibling colony) implemented

gaps.notes: The DM fork copytree-merges the queen session into a fresh colony session dir, rewrites meta.json, schedules a bounded background compaction into the colony's seed conversation and awaits the marker before opening the session; every stage is fail-soft to the raw copied transcript. Memories are not copied on either side (queen-scope memories stay shared).
gaps.title: DM fork into a colony copies and compacts the source session

gaps.notes: fork_session_into_colony now refuses a source without a queen executor or registered queen node with a 503 before the colony directory is created. writeColonyFromSession snapshots the live queen surface into worker.json: tool snapshot, rendered skills catalog filtered for her phase, protocols prompt, allowlisted skill dirs, loop config, queen phase/id, tracker binding in input_data, and the handoff goal. The fork also persists source provenance (agent_path/agent_name, spawn lock, colony binding on the source record) and metadata.json source_session_id/worker spawned_at.
gaps.title: DM fork worker.json inherits the live queen surface

gaps.notes: Worker surface now discovers framework/preset/user plus queen and colony scopes, with colony overriding same-name lower scopes.
gaps.title: colony worker skill catalog missed framework/user scopes

gaps.notes: Role-default preset skills are applied when building the worker catalog.
gaps.title: queen profile default_preset_skills not wired into worker catalog

gaps.notes: The loop now computes the upstream payload and the session bus subscription runs one long reflection; proactive microcompaction emits nothing.
gaps.title: compaction did not publish context_compacted / run long reflection

gaps.notes: AdenCredentialClient ports the Aden platform endpoints over Bearer auth: list integrations, get credential (auto-refresh), request refresh and validate token, plus health/close. It keeps upstream's config/env resolution, retry/backoff on connection and 5xx failures, and typed auth/not-found/refresh/rate-limit errors. Production call sites are unchanged: agent_validation.go still records the Aden token pre-sync as a no-op, so this gap covers the client port only.
gaps.title: Aden credential HTTP client is ported

gaps.notes: Reference baseline 6703b434 contains only core/framework/cloud_sync_hooks.py: core/framework/cloud_sync.py is absent (git cat-file -e exits 128) and no reachable commit ever added it. schedule_push imports framework.cloud_sync inside its try block, so the missing module raises ModuleNotFoundError and is swallowed by `except Exception`, returning before _safe_push is ever scheduled. The hook is therefore an observable no-op in the frozen baseline, and Go's nil MemoryRouteDeps.SchedulePush in internal/server/app.go is behaviorally equivalent. No cloud-sync scheduler/uploader was implemented; the hook could only do work if a deployed Python package supplied framework.cloud_sync outside this repo.
gaps.title: memory cloud-sync schedule_push is a no-op in the reference baseline

gaps.notes: The hand-maintained config-support-ledger anchor now points at writeCompactionReport(agentCtx, ratioBefore, ratioAfter, preInventory).
gaps.title: HIVE_COMPACTION_DEBUG ledger anchor went stale after loop split
